methodology.title: منهجية استخراج مواضيع الكتابة (Writing Topics)
methodology.description: يتم استخراج مواضيع الكتابة من نهاية كل درس في كتاب الطالب وكتاب النشاط.

topics.title: Write an email to a friend about a problem in your school
guiding_questions: What is the problem in your school?
How can we solve this problem?
What is your opinion about this solution?
topics.sample_essay: Dear Ahmed, I want to tell you about a problem in our school. The main issue is that students throw litter everywhere in the playground. This makes the school look dirty and it is not healthy for us. I think we should put more rubbish bins around the playground. Also, we can teach students to keep the school clean. In my opinion, if everyone helps, our school will be a better place. What do you think? Your friend, Ali

topics.title: Write an email to a classmate about a problem in your class
guiding_questions: What problem do you have in your class?
What are the reasons for this problem?
What can you do to solve it?
Why do you think this solution will work?
topics.sample_essay: Dear Saeed, I want to talk about a problem in our class. Some students talk a lot during the lesson, so the teacher cannot explain well. I think this happens because some students do not pay attention. We can solve this by sitting in a quiet place and listening to the teacher carefully. I believe this solution will help us understand the lesson better. What do you think? Your friend, Khalid
